chunks: Al-Hussein ibn Yahya al-Bajaly narrated that his father narrated that Abu Zar'at narrated that Ahmad ibn al-Qasim narrated that Qatn ibn Naseer narrated that Ja'far narrated that Yaqoob ibn al-Fazl, from Sharik ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul Rahman al-Mozani, from his father, that God's Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said:

I have been granted nine characteristics due to Ali: three are for this world; three are for the Hereafter; two are for him and one is what I fear for him. And the three for this world are: he will be the one to cover up my private parts; he will be the one in charge of the affairs of my Household; and he will be my Trustee in my family. And the three for the Hereafter are: when I am given the Flag of Praise in the Hereafter, I will grant it to him to carry and I will lean on it at the time of the Rising for Intercession; and he will assist me at the gates of Paradise. The two that are for him are that he will not turn into an unbeliever or go astray after me. And the one I fear for him is that the Quraysh will act treacherously with him after me.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ بِأَمْرِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: The one in charge of the affairs of my Household

ai.seo_question: What are the nine characteristics granted to Imam Ali by the Prophet?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Khisal highlights the unique spiritual and temporal status of Imam Ali (as) through nine distinct gifts, emphasizing his role as the Prophet's successor and intercessor. The inclusion of 'Sat'ra' (covering the Prophet's private parts) underscores his closeness and trustworthiness, while the 'Liwā' al-Hamd' (Flag of Praise) in the Hereafter signifies his preeminence among the faithful during the Day of Judgment. The warning regarding the treachery of the Quraysh provides historical context for the eventual challenges he faced after the Prophet's passing.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 9-6 Al-Hussein ibn Yahya al-Bajaly narrated that Abu Zar’at quoted Ahmad ibn al-Qasim, on the authority of Qatn ibn Naseer, on the authority of Ja’far , on the authority of Yaqoob ibn al-Fazl, on the authority of Sharik ibn Abdullah ibn Abdul Rahman al-Mozani, on the authority of his father that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“I have been granted nine characteristics due to Ali (MGB): three are for this world; three are for the Hereafter; two are for him and one is what I fear for him. And the three for this world are: he will be the one to cover up my private parts ; he will be the one in chargeof the affairs of my Household; and he will be my Trustee in my family. And the three for the Hereafter are: when I am given the Flag of Praise (‘Leva ul-Hamd) ’ in the Hereafter, I will grant it to him to carry and I will lean on it at the time of the Rising for Intercession; and he will assist me at the gates of Paradise. The two that are for him are that he will not turn into an unbeliever or go astray after me. And the one I fear for him is that the Quraysh will act treacherously with him after me.”
